description: Source code implementing an integer set data structure with encoding, search, add, remove, and validation functions, including test routines.

methods.name: intsetNew
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new empty integer set.

methods.name: intsetAdd
methods.description: Adds a value to the set, upgrading encoding if necessary.

methods.name: intsetRemove
methods.description: Removes a value from the set if present.

methods.name: intsetFind
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the set.

methods.name: intsetRandom
methods.description: Returns a random element from the set.

methods.name: intsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value at a specific position.

methods.name: intsetLen
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the set.

methods.name: intsetBlobLen
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the set's data blob.

methods.name: intsetValidateIntegrity
methods.description: Validates the internal consistency and integrity of the set.
